title: The Missing Adapter
transcript:
Man: The projector in conference room B won't connect to my laptop. I've tried everything.
Woman: Did you use the gray adapter in the drawer? The new laptops need it.
Man: There's no adapter in the drawer. Someone must've walked off with it.
Woman: Typical. I've got one at my desk you can borrow.
Man: You're a lifesaver. My client call starts in ten minutes.
Woman: Just bring it back afterward, or I'll be in the same boat tomorrow.

questions.stem: Why does the woman say, "I'll be in the same boat tomorrow"?
options: She also has a client call today.
She will need the adapter herself.
She plans to replace the projector.
She thinks the man will be late again.
questions.explanation: "In the same boat" means in the same situation: without the adapter, she would have the man's problem tomorrow.

options: He forgot the time of his client call.
He can't find conference room B.
His laptop battery is almost empty.
He can't connect his laptop to the projector.
questions.explanation: He says the projector "won't connect to my laptop."
